presets.name: Requested spot
presets.note: HD requested 2026-10-17 for a friend hunting 10-18/19

bundle.description: Topo, imagery, LiDAR relief and contours, forest stands, water, roads, and the habitat, wind and going grids around Clearwater; full detail within 5 km of the spot.

ecoregion.name: Clear Hills and Western Alberta Uplands

basemap.missing: not baked: the map draws the live NRCan base map

topo.source: Toporama hypsography (contours and spot heights), NRCan WMS

dem.source: MRDEM 30 m, with HRDEM 1 m LiDAR over the core (mrdem-30), NRCan

understory.source: Bush model (docs/BUSH-MODEL.md): the eye-level understory predicted at 30 m from Sentinel-2 seasons, PALSAR, SCANFI, CanLaD and the MRDEM, trained on 435 plots of Ontario leaf-on LiDAR; faded where the model is unsure. Modelled, not measured
understory.licence: Copernicus Sentinel data; JAXA ALOS PALSAR mosaic (free, attribution); OGL-Canada; CanLaD CC BY 4.0

lanes.source: The shooting lanes at stand scale from the national bush model at 30 m (docs/BUSH-MODEL.md): open and light ground clear, thicker bush shaded darker, faded where the model is unsure. A 30 m cell shows where the bush is open or thick, not a single lane. Modelled, not measured
lanes.licence: Copernicus Sentinel data; JAXA ALOS PALSAR mosaic (free, attribution); OGL-Canada; CanLaD CC BY 4.0

bathy.missing: not baked: lake depths are drawn from GeoJSON (depth)

land.source: Parks and Protected Areas of Alberta; White Area quarter sections no public layer covers (ATS v4.1 and Green/White Area), Government of Alberta

lots.source: Alberta Township System v4.1 quarter sections, Government of Alberta

forest.missing: not in the maps as GeoJSON: the map reads the stands from the forest tiles, and the GeoJSON stays the bake's input

habitat.source: derived: MRDEM, NRCan 2020 land cover, forest stands, water, wetlands, roads and burns

micro.source: derived: the habitat grid and the MRDEM

going.source: derived: HRDEM LiDAR, point-cloud bush or the forest-map estimate, water, wetlands and roads

micro-sd.source: derived: the habitat grid and the MRDEM, with the surrogate net's terrain wind in WindNinja's place (build_windsd.py)
